title: Tech Note: Porting Macintosh 4D Applications to Windows

historical_commentary.text: Only the teaser paragraph survives for this note, but its subject — converting a Mac-created 4D structure/data pair so it runs under 4D for Windows — reflects the real cross-platform portability challenges 4D developers faced in the mid-1990s. This kind of manual structure/data conversion process is obsolete today, since modern 4D databases use an OS-neutral structure file format that opens natively on Mac or Windows without conversion steps.
related_updates: Modern 4D structure files are cross-platform by design and do not require a conversion procedure to move between Mac and Windows
4D 6.0-era binary .4DB/.4DC data/structure formats have long since been superseded by the modern structure file format
